messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: CI pipeline failure detected for release/2026-03-15 — artifact signature validation failing in publish step. Canary deploys in eu-west-1 are failing health checks. Severity: P1. Paging eng-oncall.

alice: saw it, getting eyes. logs show signature verification error 'signature mismatch' from artifact-store service.

maya: on my way, pinging CI team. any eta on how many canaries affected?

jorge: seeing 5/10 canaries failing in eu-west-1, 0/4 in us-west-2. error rate ~2.3 rps, 500s from model-server verifying image digest.

alice: ok, immediate mitigation plan: stop rollout, enable kill-switch flag for canary rollout, and roll back to previous pinned digest. who can flip the flag?

release-triage: I can flip the feature flag. Which flag key?

alice: flag key: rollout.canary.autodeploy. set to false. then trigger rollback job: ci/rollback-release-2026-03-15. maya, can you run? I want a log snippet after.

maya: running now.

maya: executed:
```
# disable automatic canary promotion
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $SECRETS" https://flags.internal/api/set -d '{"key":"rollout.canary.autodeploy","value":false}'
# trigger rollback pipeline
cictl pipeline run rollback --release=2026-03-15
```

sre-bot: rollback job queued (job id: rb-20260315-77). Notifying deployers.

pagerduty: Incident acknowledged by alice. On-call handoff in 45m from now.

jorge: I see rollback job started, rolling to digest sha256:aaaabbbbcccc earlier-known-good.

alice: patch to CI: add stricter signature validation logs and fail-open disabled. We should also audit the registry for recent retags.

maya: audit running: querying registry for last 48h pushes for repo model-server:release/2026-03-15

maya: found two pushes within CI window, one by automatic rebuild job and one by manual re-sign. timestamps: 2026-03-15T02:11Z and 02:17Z. suspicious.

jorge: sounds like a re-sign/retag race. could be a race in our signing service or a malformed signer job that reissued digest with different signature metadata.

alice: for customer impact: internal metric shows 12 customer requests failed end-to-end (dedicated + hosted canaries) in eu-west-1, support is being looped in. No broader customer errors yet.

release-triage: support notified, slack thread to #support-created. I'll paste a short blurb for status page.

sre-bot: rollback completed on canaries (rb-20260315-77) — rollouts reverted to sha256:aaaabbbbcccc. Health checks green in 5/10 previously failing canaries; continuing to warm.

alice: good. next steps: hold release, disable automatic publishers until CI sign/verify lock fixed, assign postmortem. jorge, can you take lead on sign-service debug? maya please help with registry audit and retention of bad artifacts.

jorge: taking lead. I'll collect logs and add to postmortem doc. starting triage now.

release-triage: handoff to night oncall (alice -> night_oncall_lee) at 23:00 UTC. leaving notes in #incidents and in runbook.

alice: thanks team. summary for status page: deploy paused, rollback succeeded on canary, investigation underway into artifact signing/retag race. will update in 30m. :white_check_mark:
